parts.text: Which claim correctly decides which angle is larger?

options.text: Angle $P$ is larger, because it has the greater amount of turn about the vertex.
Angle $Q$ is larger, because its arms are drawn longer.
Decorative arrowheads on the rays decide which angle is larger.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Dev draws two angles on plain paper. Angle $P$ has short arms and a wide turn about its vertex. Angle $Q$ has long arms and a narrow turn about its vertex.

part_answers.answer: Angle size is the amount of turn about the vertex from one ray to the other, so the wider turn at $P$ makes angle $P$ larger.

teacher.key_rationale: Size is the amount of turn, not arm length or decoration. Angle P has the wider turn, so it is larger.
